labels.name: bug
labels.description: Something is broken or behaves incorrectly

labels.name: enhancement
labels.description: New capability or improvement to existing behaviour

labels.name: documentation
labels.description: Docs, prose, diagrams, READMEs, ADRs

labels.name: refactor
labels.description: Restructuring that preserves observable behaviour

labels.name: tech-debt
labels.description: Known shortcut, drift, or hygiene owed - includes cleanup

labels.name: testing
labels.description: Tests, benchmarks, fuzzing, property checks, coverage

labels.name: chore
labels.description: Routine maintenance with no behaviour change

labels.name: research
labels.description: Open investigation; the outcome is knowledge, not code

labels.name: decision
labels.description: A ruling is required before work can proceed

labels.name: question
labels.description: Further information is requested

labels.name: cicd
labels.description: CI/CD: workflows, actions, lockfiles, pins, runners, release gates

labels.name: security
labels.description: Security posture, secrets, scanning, advisories, supply chain

labels.name: proofs
labels.description: Formal verification: Agda, Coq, Idris, Lean, Z3/SMT, axiom debt

labels.name: governance
labels.description: Policy, rulesets, standards, compliance, and their enforcement

labels.name: design
labels.description: Design of an interface, protocol, grammar, or type theory

labels.name: architecture
labels.description: Structural/system-level shape and runtime behaviour

labels.name: performance
labels.description: Throughput, latency, memory, binary size

labels.name: bindings
labels.description: ABI, FFI, WASM, and cross-language interop surfaces

labels.name: migration
labels.description: Porting between languages or toolchains (e.g. -> AffineScript)

labels.name: packaging
labels.description: Guix, Nix, containers, distribution artefacts

labels.name: licensing
labels.description: Licences, SPDX headers, REUSE compliance, attribution

labels.name: automation
labels.description: Bots, schedulers, dispatch, self-healing, fan-out

labels.name: scaffolding
labels.description: RSR templates, repo init, instantiation, project skeletons

labels.name: conformance
labels.description: Conformance to an external or internal specification

labels.name: priority:p0
labels.description: Critical - drop other work

labels.name: priority:p1
labels.description: High - schedule next

labels.name: priority:p2
labels.description: Normal - queue it

labels.name: priority:p3
labels.description: Low - nice to have

labels.name: status:blocked
labels.description: Cannot proceed until a dependency clears

labels.name: status:ready
labels.description: Fully specified and ready to be picked up

labels.name: status:needs-owner
labels.description: Unassigned and needs someone to take it

labels.name: status:needs-ruling
labels.description: Awaiting an owner decision

labels.name: status:do-not-automate
labels.description: Bots and sweeps must not touch this issue

labels.name: meta:umbrella
labels.description: Parent issue aggregating child issues

labels.name: meta:campaign
labels.description: Coordinated multi-repo push with a defined end state

labels.name: meta:roadmap
labels.description: Forward planning; not yet actionable work

labels.name: meta:recurring
labels.description: Recurs on a schedule or by trigger; never finally closed

labels.name: scope:estate
labels.description: Affects many or all repos across the estate

labels.name: scope:repo
labels.description: Confined to this repository
